description_detailed: To celebrate the 25th anniversary of the cinema release of the first chapter of Peter Jackson's trilogy, Monnaie de Paris will unveil a collection of precious coins dedicated to the legendary Lord of the Rings series in 2026. From the Shire to Mordor, the perilous journey of the Fellowship of the Ring is now engraved in metal, celebrating a mythical saga that has become a true pillar of the fantasy genre.The emblem of the Kingdom of Rohan, the flag adorned with the white horse symbolises freedom and the unbreakable bond between the Rohirrim and their steeds. Meaning ‘Land of Horses’ in Sindarin, Rohan was a decisive ally of Gondor during the battles against the Dark Lord Sauron. The perfect gift for fans of The Lord of the Rings saga, this pure gold collector's coin will increase in value over time and will always be worth at least its face value.
